headlines.title: Shingles plummets among younger adults but is mysteriously rising in another group
headlines.description: Shingles is dropping among people who got chickenpox shots but mysteriously rising in people 35 and older, new research shows.

headlines.title: When teens get colorectal cancer, it’s often an aggressive form of the disease
headlines.description: Only a tiny number of colorectal cancer cases occur in people younger than 21, but they’re often diagnosed at later stages and more difficult to treat.

headlines.title: Med Student Recalls ‘Concerning’ First Signs of Leukemia Before Her Diagnosis at 22
headlines.description: Just a month after starting her first job out of college, she experienced scary symptoms that led to a cancer diagnosis and rare relapses.

headlines.title: Why Sharing Your Family's Health History With Doctor is Important
headlines.description: Knowing your family medical history is essential for understanding your health, so NBC News medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal stops by TODAY to share some helpful tips, including building a family health tree, asking your family questions, and more.

headlines.title: Doctor Puts Spotlight on Overlooked Women’s Health Topics
headlines.description: From menopause to healthy digestion, there can sometimes be vital information missing from conversations surrounding women’s health so Dr. Jennifer Ashton, board-certified in OBGYN and obesity medicine with a master’s in nutrition, joins TODAY to help fill-in some of the blanks.

headlines.title: Amanda Peet on ‘Your Friends & Neighbors,’ Family, Cancer Battle
headlines.description: Actor Amanda Peet joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to chat about Season Three “Your Friends & Neighbors,” who her celebrity crush is, learning slang from her kids and parenting teens. Then, they are joined by Dr. Keith Flaherty, president of the American Associate for Cancer Research, to discuss her experience with breast cancer and share advancements in research and treatment.

headlines.title: Start TODAY’s October Challenge: Routine Revamp, Healthy Meals
headlines.description: October is the perfect time to revamp your routines, so fitness contributor Stephanie Mansour stops by Studio 1A to break down some easy Start TODAY workouts, which can be accessed for free on the app this month. TODAY nutrition and health expert Joy Bauer also shares some simple meals, including a French toast grilled cheese, cottage cheese fettuccine alfredo, pumpkin peanut butter, and more!

headlines.title: 6 leaf blowers that make fall yard cleanup easy and quick
headlines.description: To find the best leaf blowers to clean up leaves this fall, we spoke to lawn maintenance and gardening experts for their guidance and product recommendations.

headlines.title: New early October Prime Day deals just dropped — I hand-picked 57+ worth shopping (live updates)
headlines.description: Prime Big Deal Days is back October 6 to 7, but you can shop early deals today. Our editors are finding new discounts live from iRobot, Ninja, Lego and more.

headlines.title: How does Walmart+ compare to Amazon Prime? Here's what to know
headlines.description: How does Walmart+ compare to Amazon Prime? What to know about benefits, pricing and free trials.

headlines.title: Target, Walmart, Best Buy and more stores have pre-Prime Day sales with up to 75% off
headlines.description: The strongest fall deals from Walmart, Target, Best Buy and other retailers, all vetted by NBC Selected editors.

headlines.title: This Dad Walks 4 Miles a Day With a Trash Can on His Back. He’s Lost 135 Pounds
headlines.description: Curtis “Dusty” Stilwell lost 135 pounds by walking every day and picking up trash. He explains his diet changes and how the routine boosts his mental health.
